meta.title: DSH Workspace Focus Enhancer
meta.description: Workspace list enhancements: pin workspaces to the top, float busy ones forward, collapse the others when you open one, highlight the workspace holding the session on screen, replace the folder icon with a workspace status folder (amber = waiting for you, red = a session failed, a green snake running = work in progress, eight solid blocks = finished unread), and star favourite sessions. The plugin page offers eight switches.
